mission: At the camp above the Scar, Ben watches Torin watching the valley and reads one more piece of Veraine's working mind before morning comes.
why_now: The chapter needs to end on held breath. The group has arrived, the world is wrong, and the last night before the break should carry both Torin's longing and Veraine's intellect.
conflict: Nothing happens here except waiting, reading, and understanding what that waiting means. Torin is already leaning toward the valley, and Veraine's note proves she is still thinking a move ahead.
turning_point: Ben sees the longing in Torin's stillness and understands that tomorrow has already started for him.
opening_hook: They make camp at the valley's edge. The Scar is visible from here — a thin line in the air that should not be there. Torin has not looked away from it since they arrived
closing_hook: Night on Veranthos. The Scar visible against the stars — a line of absence in the sky. Torin standing at the camp's edge, looking down at the valley. His expression: peaceful, decided, already gone. Ben watches from the tent and knows: tomorrow. On the datapad beside him, Veraine's ledger entry still open — a mind at work, a mind ahead
emotional_trajectory: Grim preparation -> watching Torin -> the terrible certainty of what is coming -> the adjacent weight of Veraine's working mind in the margin

stakes.personal: Ben's last hours before the second plot point — the dread of recognition; Ben registering that Veraine is ahead of Gavran on Gavran's own ground
stakes.interpersonal: The group's fragile cohesion about to break
stakes.external: Veraine at the epicenter, Torin about to move, the clock at zero; the structural feature Veraine has identified will pressure the Ch 25-26 decision without having been announced

setting: Veranthos — valley edge camp, night, the Scar visible
sensory_details: The Scar outlined against the stars — a line of absence in the sky; Torin's silhouette at the camp edge, motionless; the wound's pull constant and gravitational at close range; Veranthos's wrong night sounds — silence where there should be insects, a hum where there should be wind; the datapad's low glow at Ben's knee; the ledger entry's diction — no contractions, academic syntax, short working sentences, precise, certain, minimal affect, unaddressed to any reader; the specific structural sentence at the entry's end — a single observation about a feature of Gavran's containment work Gavran himself did not name
canon_elements_needed: Gavran-era containment theory — Weave-architecture structural feature (unnamed by Gavran, identified by Veraine)
Sith working-philosophy archive register (continuity with Ch 17 and Ch 19 ledger-fragments)
